message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: In 1998, Pan transferred his land (宅基地) to Li for 7000 yuan, Li got land use certificate, later got construction permit. In 2011, Pan, using concealment, transferred the same land again to victim Su, fraudulently obtaining 30,000 yuan. Su discovered fraud, reported, Pan was detained for fraud. Pan's relative repaid 30,000. Victim forgave. Pan had prior conviction for illegal acquisition and illegal logging of forest trees, with a probation period from 2010-11-08 to 2011-11-07.

Thus charges: Fraud (诈骗) for selling same land twice. Also possibly illegal land transaction? The law: Fraud (诈骗罪) is appropriate. Also maybe "非法转让宅基地" but that is a civil matter. The prior conviction is irrelevant for new charge. So likely only "诈骗". However sometimes they also charge "非法占用农用地" but not in examples. The examples show they label "贷款诈骗", "故意伤害;非法买卖制毒物品", "合同诈骗", "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章", "猥亵儿童", "危险驾驶;私分国有资产". So they combine multiple charges if multiple crimes. Here only fraud. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.

Check if also "非法转让宅基地" is a crime under Chinese law: "非法转让宅基地" is a violation of land management, could be a crime of "非法转让宅基地" (刑法第337条?). Actually Chinese criminal law has "非法转让土地使用权" (illegal transfer of land use rights) as a crime. But the facts: He transferred land he no longer owned (since already transferred to Li). That is fraudulent. So fraud covers it. Might also be "非法占用农用地" but not indicated. So answer: 诈骗.

Thus final JSON.
